EngLawName: Organic Act for Children, Youth and Family Support Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare
name: 衛生福利部兒少及家庭支持署組織法
histories: All 6 articles enacted and promulgated in accordance with presidential order Decree Yi No. 11500094151 on September 30, 2026; pursuant to Article 6, the effective date shall be stipulated by the Executive Yuan in the form of orders.

articles.content: The Ministry of Health and Welfare shall establish a Children, Youth and Family Support Administration (hereinafter as “the Administration”) to handle matters concerning child and youth health, welfare, rights and family support services.

The Administration shall have one director-general whose rank shall be equivalent to or at Grade 13 for selected appointment, and two deputy directors-general ranked at Grade 12 for selected appointment.
Regarding the appointment of the director-general mentioned in the preceding paragraph, priority shall be given to candidates with ex-officio posts.
The Administration shall have a chief secretary ranked at Grade 11 for selected appointment.
The official ranks, grades and quotas for the positions within the Administration shall be stipulated separately via an organizational chart.
The effective date of the Act shall be stipulated by the Executive Yuan in the form of orders.
